title: The weeCee: A Tiny New MS-DOS & Windows Gaming PC!
summary: LGR reviews the weeCee, a tiny mini PC that boots MS-DOS and Windows from a microSD card. It offers Sound Blaster Pro and General MIDI compatibility with VGA output, and the video tries it with DOS and Windows 98 games.
why: Cited as an example of a compact, ready-made way to play retro DOS games on real hardware without collecting old machines.

quote.text: If you want to play games on real hardware but don't feel like collecting (and troubleshooting) old hardware.
